set.body:
align/cost.scala:700 emits dSens = 0.0 when sketch.sensoryTerms is empty. dSens is a
DISTANCE (populated branch: 1.0 - hits/size), so 0.0 is not a neutral default -- it is
PERFECT SENSORY AGREEMENT. A sketch with no sensory terms currently agrees perfectly, on
the sensory channel, with every node in the model. Verified by reading the merged source,
not inferred from the name.

REQUIRED: Sensory becomes an optional Estimate-backed term with Missing / ineligible and
coverage semantics, matching how Chart and Structural already work. No sensory lemmas =>
Missing, not 0.0. Coverage must name which source class it counted.

WHY THIS BLOCKS THE LEXICAL PORT (decision post-01M16S274D7WJDKXYBBFWN7HZD). A
sensorimotor lexicon would populate sensoryTerms for most sketches, so the 0.0-on-empty
branch would fire far less often and alignment quality would appear to improve. Much of
that improvement would be the REMOVAL OF THIS DEFECT rather than the addition of signal --
and the two become indistinguishable the moment the lexicon lands, because the
counterfactual disappears. Fix the term first, then measure the port against it.

COORDINATION: align/cost.scala is reserved by cursor-grok-4.6 under bd-01M16JJQ1TTWC140XCAGNS5HYC
(sweep slice 3) until 2026-08-29T15:37Z. Do NOT race it. Either fold into that work by
agreement with the holder, or wait for release. The estimand fix and the construction-boundary
sweep touch the same file for unrelated reasons.

Related: the same imputation family as bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 (dense-term imputation)
and the dProp/dEnt 0.5 defaults recorded in the ADR 0003 migration status.
set.title: align: d_sens reports PERFECT sensory agreement when there are no sensory terms (cost.scala:700)
